visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a white mesh top over a blue tank top and blue wide-leg pants, dances excitedly in a large, bright airport-style terminal with glass ceilings and departure signs. (2) She transitions to an indoor setting with white walls featuring cartoon character illustrations; she winks at the camera and makes 'claw' gestures with her hands. (3) She visits an exhibition in a shopping mall with large character statues seated at a table and themed neon signs in the background. (4) Holding a pink star-shaped wand, she interacts with glowing star-shaped lights and explores a cage-like display containing character figures in striped prison uniforms. (5) She is seen outdoors in a public plaza surrounded by massive inflatable cartoon characters, holding green shopping bags filled with merchandise. (6) Montage of a blue tram (ding-ding car) and a subway station gate, both decorated with blue and white character decals. (7) She sits in a restaurant setting showing off McDonald's paper cups and food boxes with character art. (8) The video concludes with her performing a energetic dance routine in multiple themed locations, ending with a triumphant pose in front of an outdoor display.
